searchText: you could try the annotated spec like this https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec or maybe this: https://benjaminion.xyz/eth2-annotated-spec/ do you have a more specific question? if you are curious about timings of things during a slot i would reference the validator guide under the phase 0 spec Here is the consensus-spec github https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs (not annotated) Are there any *must ask* questions before locking up funds with a professional staking provider? I.e., to be on the look out for this is a bit of naive question. But would it be possible to mitigate chain splits due to a majority client bug (or other issue affecting >2/3 of validators) by scaling the # of epochs required for justification by the share of validators voting. So for instance if >90% voted it would be 1 epoch and then scaling up to say 2048 epochs at (2/3)+1 validators this would give time to resolve client issues before finalizing the chain
